text:
Alex: Heads-up: we're seeing a 2-3x tail latency on TP-backed fused-attn when seq len distribution is bimodal. Spike starts after ~20k requests. Profiling shows repeated QKV all-gathers on shard sizes that used to be no-op.
Alex: profile excerpt:
perf: cpu 0.1ms | gpu kernel fused_attn_forward 0.6ms | ncclAllGather 1.8ms x8
Also seeing KV cache scatter count: 12 per request (expected 1)
Repro: ./scripts/run_tp_infer.sh --model t0-3b --seq 1024,64 --batch 4
Log: `KVShardMismatch: expected 8 got 16` once.
Maya: can you confirm this is only on fused path? or also unfused?
Alex: only fused-attn kernel path. unfused-perf stable. kernel-selection started picking fused for these shard dims after last compaction change.
Ryan: I think batching heuristic allowed mixed seqs into same microbatch, causing padding->allgather blowup. Workaround: force same-length microbatching: `--microbatch-len 64` or set env REDWOOD_FORCE_UNFUSED=1
Maya: reproed locally, NCCL time dominates. here's quick perf sample:
```
NCCL AllGather 78.4%  (1.2ms)
fused_attention_forward 12.3% (0.18ms)
KV scatter 9.3% (0.14ms)
```
Sasha: PR #4321 updated kernel selector to check `tp_shard % qkv_block == 0` before enabling fused. might be related. ping @eng-runtime for review.
Alex: can someone bisect to the kernel-selection roll? suspect commit 9f2b4e1
Ryan: I'll bisect; if it's the selector change we can revert quickly. In the meantime adding a kludge in router: if seq variance > 256 disable fused for that route.
Maya: For Dedicated customers, this hits hard. Also KV cache compaction bug: stale shards not compacting -> double scatter. Filing a ticket.
perf-bot: automated flamegraph uploaded: https://redwood-s3/perf/1843200000-flame.svg :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Alex: thanks. Ryan, can you do a hotfix for router flags? Sasha, will review PR. Update by EOD please.
